data.gender_notes: Nawafil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'nawafa' which means 'to fall', this name symbolizes the act of falling in devotion and worship of Allah. It is often associated with righteousness and strong faith. The name Nawafil carries the meaning “Devotion, Worship” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawafil usually hope their child will grow to embody devotion, worship and live with faith, good character and purpose.
